dedupe_keys.name: sigrian italy s national information system for irrigation water management crea

description: CREA produced SIGRIAN, whose database gives information on collective irrigation in Italy: the organisation and management of the irrigation bodies, the use of water (irrigated crops and volumes), and the irrigation schemes with their sources of supply and the development and characteristics of their networks. Coverage is Italy's collective irrigation, run by the bodies responsible for irrigation. The data are free to consult online on the SIGRIAN site. Caveats: the footer reserves all rights, and the page does not give years or update dates. Simulation uses: irrigation network and supply source data for demand and drought planning. Related records: the GRAIN irrigation network registry (data-grain-global-registry-agricultural-irrigation-networks).
